title: What to do when your partner is stressed

slides.title: What to do when your partner is *stressed*
slides.sub: Small things that help more than you think.

slides.title: Ask: *advice or a hug?*
slides.body: Sometimes they want solutions. Sometimes they just want you.

slides.title: Take one thing *off their list.*
slides.body: The errand, the email, the dishes. Just one.

slides.title: Make their *favorite drink.*
slides.body: No questions asked. Just set it down next to them.

slides.title: Be quiet, *but stay.*
slides.body: You don’t have to fill the silence. Just be close.

slides.title: Plan something *to look forward to.*
slides.body: A takeaway on Friday. A walk on Sunday. Something small.

slides.title: Remind them: *we’ll figure it out.*
slides.body: Not “it’s fine.” Just “we’re in this together.”

slides.title: Save this *for when they need it.*
slides.sub: Then quietly start with number two.
